notes.notes:

[b]VoxPop Games[/b] first micro-publishing endeavor is available for Summer Sale Purchase - with 40% OFF 

WEAPONEER by [b]PLUG_WORLD[/b], Congratulations, Once again to our amazingly talented #indiegamedev partner, Parker Anderson for this tremendous accomplishment!!

Cheers to the The AbleGamers Charity for their support of the project, #SoEveryoneCanGame
